meta.name: google-maps-search-api-skill
meta.description: This skill is designed to help users automatically extract business data from Google Maps search results. The Agent should proactively apply this skill when the user makes the following requests searching for coffee shops in a specific city, finding dentists or medical clinics nearby, tracking competitors' locations in a certain area, extracting business leads from Google Maps lists, gathering restaurant data for market research, finding hotels or accommodation options in a region, locating specific services like coworking spaces or gyms, monitoring new business openings in a neighborhood, collecting contact information and addresses for sales prospecting, analyzing price ranges and cuisines of local eateries, getting ratings and review counts for a list of businesses, exporting local business data into a CRM or database.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从谷歌地图自动提取商家数据
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要从谷歌地图批量获取商家信息用于销售或分析。
copy.tagline_en: Automatically extract business data from Google Maps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to batch collect business info from Google Maps for sales or analysis.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能根据你的要求，自动从 Google 地图搜索结果中提取商家数据，如名称、地址、评分、评论数、价格范围等。
howto.when: 当你提出搜索特定城市咖啡店、附近牙医、竞争对手位置、提取商家线索等涉及 Google 地图数据的需求时触发。

say.text: 帮我找一下曼哈顿的意大利餐厅。
say.note: Claude 会调用技能搜索并返回结果。

say.text: 提取伦敦房地产中介的名单。
say.note: Claude 会提取商家数据供你使用。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can automatically extract business data from Google Maps search results based on your request, including name, address, rating, review count, price range, etc.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to search for coffee shops in a specific city, find nearby dentists, track competitor locations, extract business leads from Google Maps, etc.

say_en.note: Claude will use the skill to search and return results.

say_en.text: Extract a list of real estate agencies in London.
say_en.note: Claude will extract business data for you.
